# Pablo Cirre - Developer Portfolio & Projects

> Personal website of Pablo Cirre: web development, Big Data, OpenData products, training, interactive labs and professional project evidence.

## Key Sections

### Main
- [Home](https://pablocirre.github.io/) - Overview of expertise in data, web products, training and digital interfaces.
- [About Me](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/about-me/) - Biography, experience and public profile.
- [Projects](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/projects/) - Portfolio of client work, data products and digital properties.
- [Services](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/services/) - Professional services.
- [Knowledge](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/knowledge/) - Technical and editorial knowledge hub.
- [Docencia](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/docencia/) - Training and education activity.
- [Interactividad](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/interactividad/) - Interactive and videogame-related work.
- [Vocalware](https://pablocirre.github.io/vocalware/) - TTS and voice synthesis reference page.

### OpenData
- [OpenData Main](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/opendata/) - Business data and OpenData products.
- [Central de Comunicacion](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/opendata/centraldecomunicacion/) - Spanish B2B data provider project.
- [Companies Data](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/opendata/companiesdata/) - European business databases.
- [UK Business](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/opendata/ukbusiness/) - UK business datasets.
- [Enterprises API](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/opendata/enterprises/) - Unified enterprise data concept.

### Tools
- [Tools Index](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/tools/) - Utility tools and scripts.
- [Kaiju Email Verifier](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/tools/kaijuemailverifier/) - Email verification tool.
- [Kaiju Translator](https://pablocirre.github.io/paginas/tools/kaijutranslator/) - Translation utility.

### Creative Labs
- [Labs Index](https://pablocirre.es/labs/) - Interactive experiments and UI prototypes.
